info.name: DDJ-FLX10 Screen (Native Waveform)
info.author: Victor Pineda (Veezuhz)
info.description: Jog wheel HID screen module for DDJ-FLX10. Enable alongside the main MIDI mapping.

option.label: Jog screen protocol
option.description: Must match "Jog screen mode" in the DDJ-FLX10 MIDI mapping. Serato: waveform, artwork and time (tested by Veezuhz). rekordbox: the rekordbox waveform packets decoded by Loui1979 (not yet verified on hardware). MIDI: this HID mapping stays idle.
